The topmost real hit must be the hero, not Menu, Merge or the next-goal card
  Expected: same as <Town actor momo (Mofumachi.Presentation.TownActor)>
  But was:  null

known: The new topmost-hit assertion received a non-actor top object. The raw failure does not name that object or the current edge.
fixture_defect: FrameTownPortrait changes to WorldSpace without configuring its event/render camera, then this new test projects with null. Existing real-raycast FixedViewport explicitly supplies a render-target camera and uses it for projection.
hypothesis: A consistent fixed viewport/render/event camera removes the fixture mismatch. A real product interceptor is not ruled out until the strict native topmost assertion passes.
repair_scope: Two native test files only: reuse the existing unchanged FixedViewport and add exact hit/depth/cull/camera diagnostics. No runtime/resources/capture/suite gate change.
